entry.value: Input table containing the columns to be used for ratio calculation

Metanode for ratio calculation. After selecting a set of columns, ratios of interest are specified in a respective form field.%%00010%%00010Missing values are supported and you can specify what value the ratio should be when one of the values or both of them are missing. In case the 'text' format is selected, the column containing all ratios will be written in text format due to compatibility reasons.%%00010%%00010Two ratio columns are reported - column containing ratios coming only from not missing values and column containing also ratio values when one or both cells used for ratio calculation are missing, depending on the settings (names of these columns have the prefix '_all').%%00010%%00010=================%%00010%%00010Used programs and tools and their respective licenses at the time of the metanode creation.
